	int n, m, k, t;
	vector<int> u,v,prio,curflow,prevedge,prevnode,pot;

	MCF(int n):n(n),u(n),v(n),prio(n),curflow(n),prevedge(n),prevnode(n),pot(n),adj(n){}
	priority_queue<ll, vector<ll>, greater<ll> > q;

		pair<int, int> a = {t, 0, cap, cost};
		pair<int, int> b = {s, 0, 0, -cost};
		adj[s].push_back(a);
		adj[t].push_back(b);
	}

		int flow=0, flowCost=0;
		while(flow<INF) {
			q.push(s);
			fill(ALL(prio), INT_MAX);
			prio[s]=0;
			curflow[s]=INT_MAX;

				q.pop();

					int v=e.first;

						continue;

					if (prio[v]>nprio) {
						prio[v]=nprio;
						q.push(((ll)nprio<<32)+v);
						prevnode[v]=u;
						prevedge[v]=i;
						curflow[v]=min(curflow[u], e.second-e.first);
					}
				}
			}
			if(prio[t]==INT_MAX)
				break;
			for(int i=0; i<n; ++i)
				pot[i]+=prio[i];
			int df=min(curflow[t], INF-flow);
			flow+=df;
			for(int v=t; v!=s; v=prevnode[v]) {
				pair<int, int> &e=adj[prevnode[v]][prevedge[v]];
				e.second+=df;
				adj[v][e.first].second-=df;
				flowCost+=df*e.third;
			}
		}
		return make_pair(flow, flowCost);
	}
};

	scanf("%d%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k,&c,&d);
